# Deathtrap Native 50 v0.0.240 — RicViper Gamepad Controls

![Red Lotus seen from behind, facing the Spire gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mbushuev/deathtrap-native-50/v0.0.240/assets/deathtrap-native50-banner-v0.0.240.png)

This release adds an optional gamepad layout designed and originally
implemented by **RicViper**. To try it, open **Setup → Native 50 → Page 2 →
Gamepad layout** and choose **RicViper**. **Standard** remains the default.

- **RB** casts spells. Hold **B** for controlled movement, including sidesteps
  and backing away while facing an enemy. **B + RT** keeps movement on the
  left stick during attacks.
- Tap the D-pad to cycle equipment or use quick heal. The layout remembers
  the last melee and ranged weapons separately.
- Hold the D-pad to open a radial. Highlight a weapon or spell with the
  right stick and release to select it. For potions and charms, use **A**
  while keeping the wheel open.

[Read the full RicViper gamepad guide](https://github.com/mbushuev/deathtrap-native-50/blob/v0.0.240/docs/RICVIPER-CONTROLS.md)

## Install or update

- **Windows (Steam or GOG).** Close the game and run
  **Deathtrap-Native-50-0.0.240-Setup.exe**. The installer backs up the files
  it replaces. The ZIP includes **INSTALL.cmd** for script-based installation.
- **Steam Deck.** Extract the complete ZIP in Desktop Mode and run
  `bash INSTALL-DECK.sh` from the extracted folder. Launch through Steam
  using the standard **Gamepad** layout.
- **Verification.** The SHA-256 file contains checksums for both downloads.
